hook: The last bitcoin won't be issued until around 2140.

scenes.narration: The block subsidy is expected to reach zero around the year twenty one forty.
The final blocks with a subsidy pay just one satoshi.
After that, miners earn only transaction fees.

cta: Would you still be mining? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: When Will the Last Bitcoin Be Mined?
description_body: The subsidy is expected to hit zero around 2140.
